metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2015 · Reply 1988
metas.description: Five childhood friends, who all live in the same Ssangmundong neighborhood of Seoul in 1988, lean on each other to survive their challenging teen years and set a path for their futures.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2018 · My Mister
metas.description: A man in his 40s withstands the weight of life. A woman in her 20s goes through different experiences, but also withstands the weight of her life. The man and woman get together to help each other.
